subject.title: fix(memory): honor qmd search timeout and bound one-shot CLI cleanup

question: Should memory.qmd.limits.timeoutMs extend only active QMD command execution, or should it define shared MemorySearchManager whole-search and bounded-close semantics?
rationale: Both open PRs solve the observable bug but establish different permanent API ownership and availability behavior; repository policy requires maintainer intent before expanding shared plugin-facing contracts or changing fallback and lifecycle policy.

options.title: Keep timeout policy QMD-local
options.body: Refresh the maintainer-assigned competing PR so setup, supplements, fallback, and cleanup retain the default deadline while only active QMD commands use the configured longer timeout.

options.title: Adopt shared manager budgets
options.body: Proceed with this PR and explicitly accept getSearchTimeoutMs plus close(timeoutMs) as permanent shared memory-host SDK semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep timeout policy QMD-local
recommendation.body: Refresh the maintainer-assigned competing PR so setup, supplements, fallback, and cleanup retain the default deadline while only active QMD commands use the configured longer timeout.
